page.title: 範囲・不在・話題を示す

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、withinを境界の内側、withoutを必要な物・行為とのつながりがない状態として捉え、according to、apart from、as for、as to、as of/fromで情報源・除外・話題転換・具体論点・発効時点を整理する。前置詞句全体を一つの機能単位として読むことが中心である。
grammarPoints: within＋期間は期限の外へ出ない「〜以内に」を表す
within＋範囲・距離・組織は定められた境界の内側を表す
without＋名詞または動名詞は物・行為を伴わないことを表す
according toは規則・報告・情報源に基づく内容を示し、自分の意見には通常使わない
apart fromは文脈により「〜を除いて」または「〜に加えて」を表す
as forは話題を別の対象へ移す
as toは特定の論点・疑問について述べる改まった表現である
as ofまたはas fromは指定時点からの有効・適用を表す
be familiar with、cope with、find fault withはwithを含む定着表現である
visualEvidence: WITHINが光る境界円の内側、WITHOUTが切れた接続として描かれている
according to、as for、as toへ向きを変えるスポットライトが情報源と話題の切替を示している
apart fromが対象を横へ外すカードとして配置されている
as of/fromが日付から先へ伸びる開始線として示されている
familiar with、cope with、find fault withが残りのwith表現の棚にまとめられている
commonTraps: in three daysとwithin three daysの期限境界の違いを無視する
withoutの後ろに原形動詞を直接置く
according to meで自分の意見を表そうとする
apart fromの除外用法と追加用法を文脈なしで決める
as forとas toをどちらも単純なaboutとして交換する
as ofを過去だけの表現と誤解する
be familiar toとbe familiar withの視点差を混同する

questions.prompt: Please return the signed agreement ------- five business days.

choices.B: without
choices.C: according to
choices.D: as for

questions.translationJa: 署名済みの契約書を5営業日以内に返送してください。
questions.explanationJa: 期限という境界を越えないことを示すためwithin＋期間を使います。

questions.prompt: Free delivery is available ------- a 30-kilometer radius of the store.

choices.B: within
choices.C: apart from
choices.D: as to

questions.translationJa: 店舗から半径30キロ以内では無料配送を利用できます。
questions.explanationJa: 距離で囲まれた範囲の内側をwithinで表します。

questions.prompt: The proposed change remains ------- the authority of the local office.

choices.B: according
choices.C: within
choices.D: as from

questions.translationJa: 提案された変更は現地事務所の権限内にあります。
questions.explanationJa: 権限・責任の境界内であることはwithin the authority ofで示します。

questions.prompt: The maintenance team completed the inspection ------- interrupting production.

choices.B: according to
choices.C: as of
choices.D: without

questions.translationJa: 保守チームは生産を中断せずに点検を完了しました。
questions.explanationJa: withoutの後ろに動名詞interruptingを置き、「中断することなく」を表します。

questions.prompt: Visitors may not enter the laboratory ------- protective eyewear.

choices.B: within
choices.C: as for
choices.D: according

questions.translationJa: 来訪者は保護眼鏡なしで研究室へ入ることはできません。
questions.explanationJa: 必要な物を伴わない状態はwithout＋名詞で表します。

questions.prompt: ------- the quarterly report, online sales increased by 12 percent.

choices.B: According to
choices.C: Without
choices.D: Within

questions.translationJa: 四半期報告書によると、オンライン売上は12パーセント増加しました。
questions.explanationJa: 報告書という情報源に基づく内容なのでAccording toを使います。

questions.prompt: ------- one delayed shipment, all orders arrived on schedule.

choices.B: Within
choices.C: Apart from
choices.D: According by

questions.translationJa: 1件の配送遅延を除き、すべての注文は予定どおり到着しました。
questions.explanationJa: 全体の説明から一つの例外を外すためApart fromを使います。

questions.prompt: ------- the venue, the events team recommends the Riverside Hall.

choices.B: According
choices.C: Without of
choices.D: As for

questions.translationJa: 会場については、イベントチームはリバーサイドホールを勧めています。
questions.explanationJa: 話題を会場へ切り替える導入表現はAs forです。

questions.prompt: The committee has not reached a decision ------- whether remote work will continue.

choices.B: as for of
choices.C: according
choices.D: within to

questions.translationJa: 委員会は在宅勤務を継続するかどうかについてまだ決定していません。
questions.explanationJa: 特定の疑問点whether節を導く改まった表現としてas toが適切です。

questions.prompt: The revised parking fees will apply ------- October 1.

choices.B: as of
choices.C: apart to
choices.D: without from

questions.translationJa: 改定後の駐車料金は10月1日から適用されます。
questions.explanationJa: 規則や料金が指定日から有効になることをas of＋日付で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about a deadline.

choices.A: All expense claims must be filed without ten days.
choices.B: All expense claims must be filed within of ten days.
choices.C: All expense claims must be filed within ten days.
choices.D: All expense claims within must be filed ten days.

questions.translationJa: すべての経費請求は10日以内に提出しなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: 期限の外へ出ないことはwithin＋期間で表し、ofは不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about a service area.

choices.A: The shuttle serves hotels without the downtown district.
choices.B: The shuttle serves within hotels of the downtown district.
choices.C: The shuttle serves hotels within to the downtown district.
choices.D: The shuttle serves hotels within the downtown district.

questions.translationJa: そのシャトルは中心街地区内のホテルを巡回します。
questions.explanationJa: 地理的な境界の内側にあるホテルをwithinで限定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence using without.

choices.A: The software can be updated without restarting the device.
choices.B: The software can be updated without restart the device.
choices.C: The software can be updated without to restart the device.
choices.D: The software without can be updated restarting the device.

questions.translationJa: そのソフトウェアは端末を再起動せずに更新できます。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞withoutの後ろで行為を表すときは動名詞restartingを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence citing a source.

choices.A: According the inspection record, the valve was replaced in May.
choices.B: According to the inspection record, the valve was replaced in May.
choices.C: According to me, I personally prefer the older valve.
choices.D: According by the inspection record, the valve was replaced in May.

questions.translationJa: 点検記録によると、そのバルブは5月に交換されました。
questions.explanationJa: 外部の記録を情報源として示すのでAccording to＋名詞が正しい形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence expressing an exception.

choices.A: Apart a minor scratch from, the display unit was undamaged.
choices.B: Apart of a minor scratch, the display unit was undamaged.
choices.C: Apart from a minor scratch, the display unit was undamaged.
choices.D: According from a minor scratch, the display unit was undamaged.

questions.translationJa: 小さな傷を除けば、その展示装置に損傷はありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 全体の状態に一つだけ例外を付けるときApart fromを文頭に置けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence shifting the topic.

choices.A: As to for the training date, Friday works best for our team.
choices.B: As of the training date, Friday works best for our team.
choices.C: As for to the training date, Friday works best for our team.
choices.D: As for the training date, Friday works best for our team.

questions.translationJa: 研修日については、私たちのチームには金曜日が最適です。
questions.explanationJa: 新しい話題を取り上げるAs for＋名詞が自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about a specific question.

choices.A: There is some uncertainty as to how the data should be stored.
choices.B: There is some uncertainty as for to how the data should be stored.
choices.C: There is some uncertainty according how the data should be stored.
choices.D: There is some uncertainty as of how the data should be stored.

questions.translationJa: データをどのように保存すべきかについて、いくらか不確かさがあります。
questions.explanationJa: how節という具体的論点を導くにはas to howが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about an effective date.

choices.A: As for January 1, paper invoices will no longer be issued.
choices.B: As of January 1, paper invoices will no longer be issued.
choices.C: According January 1, paper invoices will no longer be issued.
choices.D: As of from January 1, paper invoices will no longer be issued.

questions.translationJa: 1月1日付で、紙の請求書は発行されなくなります。
questions.explanationJa: 指定日から制度が有効になることをAs of＋日付で示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about familiarity.

choices.A: All reception staff are familiar to the new booking system in this meaning.
choices.B: All reception staff familiarize with the new booking system are.
choices.C: All reception staff are familiar with the new booking system.
choices.D: All reception staff are familiar the new booking system with.

questions.translationJa: 受付スタッフ全員が新しい予約システムに精通しています。
questions.explanationJa: 人が物事をよく知っている場合はbe familiar with＋対象を使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the grammatically correct sentence about handling difficulty.

choices.A: The help desk can cope a sudden increase in calls with to.
choices.B: The help desk can cope to a sudden increase in calls.
choices.C: The help desk can be cope with a sudden increase in calls.
choices.D: The help desk can cope with a sudden increase in calls.

questions.translationJa: ヘルプデスクは電話の急増に対処できます。
questions.explanationJa: cope withは「困難・状況に対処する」を表す一まとまりの動詞句です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Please respond within two working days.”

choices.A: Please wait two full working days before responding.
choices.B: Please respond no later than the end of the second working day.
choices.C: Please respond only on the second working day.
choices.D: Please respond without checking the date.

questions.translationJa: 2営業日以内に返答してください。
questions.explanationJa: within two working daysは2営業日という期限を越えないことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The repair is within our budget.”

choices.A: The repair cost does not exceed the amount we can spend.
choices.B: The repair must be completed without a budget.
choices.C: The repair cost is unknown because no budget exists.
choices.D: The repair is located inside the accounting office.

questions.translationJa: その修理費は私たちの予算内です。
questions.explanationJa: within a budgetは許容される金額の境界を超えていないことです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The driver left without signing the delivery receipt.”

choices.A: The driver signed the receipt before leaving.
choices.B: The driver left because the receipt had already been signed by everyone.
choices.C: The driver left within the time shown on the receipt.
choices.D: The driver left and did not sign the delivery receipt.

questions.translationJa: 運転手は配送受領書に署名せずに立ち去りました。
questions.explanationJa: without signingは、立ち去る行為に署名という行為が伴わなかったことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “According to the supplier, the parts will arrive Thursday.”

choices.A: The speaker personally hopes the parts will arrive Thursday.
choices.B: The parts will arrive according to a route named Supplier.
choices.C: The supplier says that the parts will arrive Thursday.
choices.D: The supplier received the parts on Thursday.

questions.translationJa: 仕入先によると、部品は木曜日に到着します。
questions.explanationJa: according to the supplierは情報の出所が仕入先であることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Apart from the lobby, every room has been renovated.”

choices.A: Only the lobby has been renovated.
choices.B: The lobby is the only room that has not been renovated.
choices.C: The lobby was renovated in addition to every room.
choices.D: No room, including the lobby, has been renovated.

questions.translationJa: ロビーを除き、すべての部屋が改装済みです。
questions.explanationJa: このapart fromは全体からlobbyを例外として除外しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “As for transportation, we will arrange a bus.”

choices.A: Turning to transportation, we plan to provide a bus.
choices.B: The bus will transport only the planning team.
choices.C: Transportation starts on the date the bus is arranged.
choices.D: The bus plan was reported by a transportation company.

questions.translationJa: 交通手段については、私たちがバスを手配します。
questions.explanationJa: As forは話題をtransportationへ移して、その話題について述べ始めます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We received no guidance as to where the equipment should be stored.”

choices.A: We were told to store the equipment immediately.
choices.B: We received a map showing every storage room.
choices.C: The equipment was stored according to a published guide.
choices.D: No one told us the proper storage location for the equipment.

questions.translationJa: 機器をどこに保管すべきかについて、私たちは何の指示も受けませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: as to whereは保管場所という具体的な疑問点を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The new policy is in force as of today.”

choices.A: The policy will be discussed sometime after today.
choices.B: The policy was canceled before today.
choices.C: The new policy becomes effective today.
choices.D: Today is merely the topic of the policy.

questions.translationJa: 新しい方針は本日付で発効します。
questions.explanationJa: as of todayは今日を効力開始の境界として示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Mina is familiar with the claims procedure.”

choices.B: Mina knows the claims procedure well.
choices.C: Mina has filed a complaint about the procedure.
choices.D: Mina designed the procedure without assistance.

questions.translationJa: ミナは請求手続きに精通しています。
questions.explanationJa: be familiar withは人が対象をよく知っていることを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The support team coped with the outage effectively.”

choices.A: The support team handled the outage successfully.
choices.B: The support team caused the outage intentionally.
choices.C: The support team ignored the outage completely.
choices.D: The outage ended before the support team arrived.

questions.translationJa: サポートチームは停止障害に効果的に対処しました。
questions.explanationJa: cope withは難しい状況を処理し、乗り切ることを表します。

questions.prompt: “When is the application due?” “It must reach us ------- seven calendar days.”

choices.B: as for
choices.C: according to
choices.D: within

questions.translationJa: 「申請期限はいつですか」「7暦日以内にこちらへ届く必要があります」
questions.explanationJa: 7日という期限の境界内に到着する必要があるためwithinを使います。

questions.prompt: “Can this technician authorize the refund?” “Yes, the amount is ------- her approval limit.”

choices.B: apart from
choices.C: within
choices.D: as to

questions.explanationJa: 承認可能額の境界を超えていないことをwithinで表します。

questions.prompt: “Why was the entry rejected?” “The visitor tried to enter ------- an identification badge.”

choices.B: without
choices.C: according to
choices.D: as of

questions.translationJa: 「なぜ入場を拒否されたのですか」「来訪者が身分証なしで入ろうとしたからです」
questions.explanationJa: 必要なbadgeを伴わない状態なのでwithout＋名詞が適切です。

questions.prompt: “Is the west road open?” “------- the traffic bulletin, it will remain closed until noon.”

choices.B: As for me
choices.C: Within
choices.D: Without

questions.translationJa: 「西側道路は開いていますか」「交通情報によると、正午まで閉鎖されたままです」
questions.explanationJa: 交通情報という外部情報源を示すためAccording toを使います。

questions.prompt: “Was the hotel satisfactory?” “Yes. ------- slow check-in, the service was excellent.”

choices.B: According by
choices.C: Within
choices.D: Apart from

questions.translationJa: 「ホテルは満足できましたか」「はい。チェックインが遅かったことを除けば、サービスは素晴らしかったです」
questions.explanationJa: 全体として高評価だが一つだけ例外があるためApart fromを使います。
questions.focus: 例外を後付けするapart from

questions.prompt: “We have discussed staffing. ------- the equipment budget, can we review it next?”

choices.D: Without of

questions.prompt: “Has the cause been confirmed?” “No conclusion has been reached ------- why the sensor failed.”

choices.B: as to
choices.C: apart from
choices.D: within of

questions.translationJa: 「原因は確認されましたか」「センサーがなぜ故障したかについて、まだ結論は出ていません」

questions.prompt: “When does my new membership begin?” “It is active ------- the date shown on your receipt.”

choices.D: with

questions.explanationJa: 人が対象に精通している場合はfamiliar withを使います。

questions.prompt: “Will the call center manage the holiday rush?” “Yes, it can cope ------- the higher volume.”

choices.B: at
choices.C: with
choices.D: from

questions.translationJa: 「コールセンターは休日期間の混雑に対応できますか」「はい、増加する件数に対処できます」
questions.explanationJa: 困難な量や状況に対処する定着表現はcope withです。
